name: Casarabonela (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casarabonela (a castle on green within an inscribed grey frame).
history: The colours of the flag are inspired by the landscape and culture of Casarabonela; the blue of water is at the base and foundation of the town and its flag.

features.role: Casarabonela arms — castle on green within an inscribed frame
